text.p: Eurotech Ltd Thursday said it received a contract from the Ukrainian State Construction Corp and the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Station Industrial Amalgamation worth about $105 million.
In a statement, the company said its foam will be applied at the damaged reactor number four building at the Chernobyl Nuclear plant. The company said the foam is highly radiation resistant.

The company said the foam will be applied at the building, and if it is determined to be acceptable in preventing airborne and waterborne escape of dangerous nucelar debri, then it would be used in the rest of the facility. The company said an estimated 35,000 cubic meters of foam would be required at about $3,000 per cubic meter, bringing the total value of the contract to $105 million.
